cool w/ cool water & air, IV fluids until T: 103; gastroprotectants & abx bc mucosal damage -> GI translocation -> sepsis; do not rapidly cool w/ice bath- vasoconstriction
Itraconazole, Amphotericin B if deteriorating animals (fungicidal)
